title: Monsoon and crop output
good_when: Rainfall is normal, sowing is up and crop prices hold, so farm incomes and input sales grow.
bad_when: Rainfall is deficient or uneven, sowing falls and low crop prices squeeze farmers' income.
current_view: Negative: ICRA (1 Oct 2026) puts 2026 monsoon rainfall at 87% of the long-period average, the lowest since 2015, and cut FY2027 agriculture GVA growth to about 1%.
source: ICRA report, 1 Oct 2026 (user-provided, verify the original)
